en.name: Eucharistic Miracle of Benningen
en.summary: A miller who withheld a Host to frame a rival for sacrilege is said to have found it bleeding.
en.body: In 1216, a miller in Benningen who kept back a consecrated Host in order to falsely accuse a rival of sacrilege was reported to have found the Host bleeding; he confessed his scheme, and the bishop of Augsburg took the relic into the Church's keeping.
